scope: 82 literal Lone Adventurer rows. Four player-name templates and one editorial-looking NPC-prefixed choice excluded,not private/live completeness.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Exhausted? me? No no no.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Выдохся? Я? Нет-нет-нет.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm just taking a break.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я просто отдыхаю.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: The End is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Энд — жуткое место, но к нему привыкаешь!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Хочешь совет? Для начала поохоться на эндерменов здесь, наверху.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: They sometimes drop important gear like the armor I'm wearing.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Из них иногда выпадает нужное снаряжение, например такая броня, как на мне.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Are you strong enough though?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Но хватит ли тебе сил?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Try killing 5 of them!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Попробуй убить 5 из них!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Alright, not bad, not bad!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Что ж, неплохо, неплохо!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: It took me a while to get that strong.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Мне понадобилось немало времени, чтобы стать таким сильным.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я пользуюсь мечом Пустоты. Это очень мощное оружие.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: It gets stronger with each piece of Ender Armor you are wearing.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Он становится сильнее с каждым надетым элементом брони Края.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I have an extremely strong emotional attachment to this item so...
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я очень сильно привязан к этому мечу, так что...

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm willing to sell it to you for the modest sum of 200,000 coins.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я готов продать его тебе за скромную сумму в 200,000 монет.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: What do you say?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Что скажешь?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Happy dealing with you, I hope this sword will help you as much as it helped me.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Рад нашей сделке. Надеюсь, этот меч поможет тебе так же, как помог мне.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: По-моему, ты совершаешь ошибку. Возможно, самую большую в своей жизни!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Are you sure you don't want that sword?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ты точно не хочешь этот меч?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Strange.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Странно.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: If you change your mind you can also go talk to Rusty in the Gold Mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Если передумаешь, можешь поговорить с Расти в Золотой шахте.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Distracted people sometimes lose their Void Sword and he sells them back.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Рассеянные люди иногда теряют свой меч Пустоты, а он продаёт им замену.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You should focus on getting all 8 pieces of the Ender Armor now.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Теперь сосредоточься на сборе всех 8 предметов комплекта Края.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Half of them are dropped by the Endermen on this layer, the other pieces are a little harder to obtain.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Половина выпадает из эндерменов на этом ярусе, а остальные элементы добыть немного сложнее.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm sure you'll figure it out.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Уверен, ты разберёшься.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the Dragon's Nest very soon.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Мне здесь больше нечего делать. Думаю, скоро спущусь в Драконье гнездо.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: See you around!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ещё увидимся!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Do you recognize me? I changed my armor!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Узнаёшь меня? Я сменил броню!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Have you found the full Ender Armor Set yet?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ты уже нашёл полный комплект брони Края?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Awesome, wear all the pieces and show me!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Здорово! Надень все элементы и покажись мне!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ah, do you need help finding the remaining pieces?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: А, тебе нужна помощь с поиском остальных элементов?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Which piece are you struggling to find?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Какой элемент тебе никак не удаётся найти?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Okay. If you need help, I'll be here.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Хорошо. Если понадобится помощь, я буду здесь.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: This one isn't too bad.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: С этим не так сложно.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You see those Seers inside the Dragon's Nest?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Видишь провидцев в Драконьем гнезде?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: If you take down enough of those you'll end up getting the Cloak.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Если победишь достаточно провидцев, рано или поздно получишь плащ.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: The Obsidian Defenders drop those Belts rarely, at least that's how I got mine.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Такие пояса изредка выпадают из обсидиановых защитников. По крайней мере, я свой получил именно так.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You haven't got this one yet?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ты его ещё не получил?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: It's just from regular Endermen, like the rest of the armor!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Он выпадает из обычных эндерменов, как и остальные части брони!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ahh, this one is a bit tricky.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: А, с этим немного сложнее.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You see those purple End Stone or Obsidian that sometimes appear around here?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Видел камень Края или обсидиан с фиолетовым свечением, которые иногда здесь встречаются?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: If you mine enough Ender Nodes you'll eventually find the Gauntlet.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Разрушай эндер-узлы, и со временем найдёшь перчатку.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Really?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Серьёзно?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: It's from those Endermen up there, where we first met.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Она выпадает из эндерменов там, наверху, где мы впервые встретились.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Are there other pieces you need info on?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Нужно рассказать ещё о каких-нибудь элементах?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Woah, you're wearing the full Ender Set!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ого, на тебе полный комплект Края!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: That's incredible, that took me at least a week!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Невероятно! У меня на это ушло не меньше недели!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You wouldn't believe what just happened, I was fighting one of those Dragons...
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Не поверишь, что сейчас случилось! Я сражался с одним из драконов...

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: The fight was going smoothly and just as I was about to land the finishing blow, BAM!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Бой шёл хорошо, и вот я уже собираюсь нанести последний удар, как вдруг — БАЦ!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: The Dragon teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Дракон телепортировался мне за спину и ударил когтями!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: That was crazy, I'm still shaking!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Это было безумие, меня до сих пор трясёт!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You said it! I thought I was going to die!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: И не говори! Я думал, мне конец!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Anyways, I'm hurt and I lost my bow in the chaos.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: В общем, я ранен и в этой суматохе потерял свой лук.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm 90% sure one of those Seers in the Dragon's Nest has it.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я на 90% уверен, что он у одного из провидцев в Драконьем гнезде.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Would you mind defeating some of them for me?
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Не мог бы ты победить нескольких из них за меня?

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm sure one of them will have my Dragon Shortbow.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Уверен, у одного из них найдётся мой драконий короткий лук.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You don't sound very excited...
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Что-то ты не в восторге...

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ah you found my Dragon Shortbow!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: А, ты нашёл мой драконий короткий лук!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I knew I saw one of those Seers grab it for themselves.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Так и знал! Я ведь видел, как один из провидцев его утащил.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Thank you so much, I owe you one.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Огромное спасибо! Я твой должник.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I got the bow from the Pearl Dealer up there near the entrance of the island.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Этот лук мне дал торговец жемчугом, что наверху, у входа на остров.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Обычно он ими не торгует, но мы с ним друзья.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'll let him know you helped me!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я расскажу ему, что ты мне помог!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Drop by his shop a little later and I'm sure he will sell you one for cheap!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Загляни к нему в магазин чуть позже. Уверен, он продаст тебе такой лук недорого!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm just about to go slay some Dragons.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я как раз собираюсь поохотиться на драконов.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Come see me later and I'll tell you all about them!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Загляни ко мне позже, и я всё тебе о них расскажу!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: For the longest time I thought I would move to the Crimson Isle or visit the Catacombs after this place.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я долго думал, что отсюда отправлюсь на Багровый остров или загляну в Катакомбы.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: But the truth is, I really like it here.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Но, честно говоря, мне здесь очень нравится.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: What I enjoyed the most was helping you and I want to stay here to help more people.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Больше всего мне понравилось помогать тебе. Хочу остаться здесь и помогать другим.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You already made a ton of progress and I'm excited for the future.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ты уже многого добился, и я с радостью жду, что будет дальше.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: ⚑ Dragon Guide is my new vocation.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: ⚑ Знаток драконов — моё новое призвание.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ask me anything regarding Dragons!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Спрашивай меня обо всём, что связано с драконами!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I want to see if you can kill at least 5 Enderman.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Хочу посмотреть, сможешь ли ты убить хотя бы 5 эндерменов.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I might give you something if you succeed.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Если справишься, возможно, я тебе кое-что дам.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I don't really know what happened around here, I'm pretty terrible in history.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я толком не знаю, что здесь произошло. В истории я совсем не силён.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Someone called me an "Ender noob" the other day, that was pretty rude.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: На днях кто-то назвал меня «эндер-нубом». Это было довольно грубо.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: You should look for End Stone or Obsidian with purple glows.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Ищи камень Края или обсидиан с фиолетовым свечением.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: They contain cool loot when mined!
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Разрушишь такие блоки — получишь отличную добычу!

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Please bring me back my bow if you find it.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Пожалуйста, верни мне мой лук, если найдёшь его.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm fairly sure one of those Seers has it.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я почти уверен, что он у одного из тех провидцев.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: The Dragon Shortbow is a powerful weapon.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Драконий короткий лук — мощное оружие.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'm going to use it to kill more Dragons as soon as I'm fully recovered.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Как только полностью поправлюсь, снова пойду с ним охотиться на драконов.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: I'd tell you more about Dragons but you're not even Combat level 18.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Я бы рассказал тебе больше о драконах, но у тебя ещё нет даже 18-го уровня боя.

records.speaker: Lone Adventurer
records.source: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Try your luck slaying some Zealots.
records.translation: [NPC] Lone Adventurer: Попытай удачу в охоте на фанатиков.
